subject: uk-geography
syllabus_source: UKSSSC master syllabus 2026-08-31, 2.8 उत्तराखण्ड का सामान्य ज्ञान
note: Facets follow the two official bullets' own commas — the first bullet is split at its full-stop into 'भौगोलिक परिचय' and 'संसाधन' as two facet groups, matching how the source itself separates them. Pass/glacier/lake naming, tehsil-district mapping, peak heights, प्रयाग confluences, landform terminology and research-institute locations were added after reading ~90 real PYQs — all recur heavily and none is named at this granularity in the bullets.
